scope: Authored symbolic receipt interfaces; physical services are unavailable

stations.name: Intake and custody
stations.scope: Certified solid targets and documented contained sphere stocks
stations.entry_gate: Identity, safety and calibration documents; empty labeled carriers
stations.boundary: No preparation until identity and containment are qualified

stations.name: Qualified specimen preparation service
stations.scope: Grating, porous coated/uncoated AAO, exposed optical-disc target and star coupon requests
stations.entry_gate: Approved service job with final-material specifications
stations.required_receipt: Finished specimen, history, certificate, ROI map and condition report
stations.boundary: No fabrication, delamination, anodization, laser, beam or deposition controls exposed

stations.name: Qualified sphere assembly and optical handling
stations.entry_gate: Accepted material state, validated handling SOP and fixture clearance
stations.required_receipt: Coating/contact state receipt including coverage and any damage
stations.boundary: Unknown recipe parameters hold this station; no guessed dilution/drying defaults

stations.name: White-light optical metrology
stations.scope: Qualified transmission/reflection microscope and registered specimen
stations.entry_gate: Calibration receipt, approved illumination/acquisition contract and safe objective-to-specimen clearance; sphere-to-target contact is part of the reported arrangement
stations.required_receipt: Immutable optical records with target, lens, mode, focus and detector metadata
stations.boundary: No high-power laser; unsafe light, collision risk or undefined contact state causes stop

stations.name: SEM dimensional reference service
stations.scope: Qualified target or accepted paired specimen
stations.entry_gate: Registered service request and preservation constraints
stations.required_receipt: Calibrated reference record, feature definitions, uncertainty and post-service state
stations.boundary: Closed instrument service, no beam/vacuum controls; flag perturbation

stations.name: Evidence and model review
stations.entry_gate: Rights-clear records, branch coverage and declared analysis conventions
stations.required_receipt: Comparison report retaining uncertainty and text-only/unrun states
stations.boundary: No new simulation and no source code execution; model fields never become measured data

stations.name: Closeout and archive
stations.scope: All specimens, fixtures, particles and records
stations.entry_gate: Qualified disposal/cleaning/storage SOP and completed state ledger
stations.required_receipt: Equipment safe-state receipt, sample disposition, immutable archive
stations.boundary: Closeout is authored because no detailed source procedure is supplied
